design_identity.aesthetic_direction: An elegant South Indian-inspired watercolour wedding invitation blended with a premium contemporary editorial website. Warm ivory paper background, watercolour botanical illustrations (banana leaves, marigold garlands, jasmine strings, temple bells), subtle gold accents, deep forest green, saffron/marigold orange, vermillion red, and deep charcoal typography.
design_identity.theme: Light mode paper texture priority. Soft ivory background (#FAF6F0) with rich warm accents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first single-page scrolling wedding invitation application in /app/frontend/src/App.js with sub-components in /app/frontend/src/components/.

Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='music-toggle-button', data-testid='rsvp-open-modal-button', data-testid='rsvp-submit-button', data-testid='carousel-next-button', data-testid='get-directions-button').
Include floating petal/marigold animation using canvas or framer-motion particles.
Include a working music player toggle button with fallback royalty-free ambient audio or simulated web audio API shehnai/flute melody.
Style using Tailwind CSS with custom font imports for Cormorant Garamond and Cinzel.
Include Sonner toast notifications when RSVP is submitted.
Do NOT use generic Vercel or Bootstrap cards. Use customized gold bordered paper textured containers.
Ensure all section requirements listed in problem statement are strictly implemented.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use pure black #000000; use warm charcoal #262626.
Never use default Inter for H1/H2 titles; use Cormorant Garamond / Cinzel.
Every interactive button must have hover effects and data-testid attributes.
Keep text contrast strictly AA compliant against warm ivory backgrounds.
No purple gradients or neon colors.
